headline: Zee Entertainment sets buyback dates; RBI restores bank CRR; IOCL faces show-cause notice over ethanol blending.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Zee Entertainment announced its buyback will open on December 1 and close on December 7
RBI restored the 90% daily CRR requirement for banks as liquidity conditions tighten
Karnataka authorities issued a show-cause notice to an IOCL terminal over excess ethanol blending
The Bombay High Court refused to stay a Tata Sons board meeting despite a challenge from Tata Trusts
whatHappening: SIMA is seeking a five-year cotton import duty waiver to address production shortfalls in India
Global retailers Zara and H&M are shifting focus to India amid garment industry disruptions in Bangladesh
The RBI Governor highlighted that AI could provide $685 billion in economic value to the MSME sector
Wall Street logged a post-Thanksgiving rally with the Nasdaq jumping 330 points on AI-related buying
summary: Zee Entertainment's upcoming buyback and RBI's liquidity tightening measures are the primary focus for market participants. Regulatory challenges for IOCL and potential supply chain shifts in the textile sector add to the domestic narrative. Positive global cues from a Wall Street rally provide a supportive backdrop for Indian markets.
